fit: fresh date extract and thermal nociception in diabetic rats
assessment: After gavage of fresh-fruit extract, hot-plate latency was 6.9 vs 3.7 seconds for vehicle. Results and Figure 1 use p<.05, while the abstract says p<.01. Tail-flick was inconclusive and its figure caption conflicts with the Methods on route. The model does not measure Parkinson pain.

fit: Khalas fruit extract and movement, memory and anxiety in APPsw/Tg2576 mice
assessment: The paper identifies the earlier FASEB abstract as the same study. The 2014 oxidative report describes a closely matched model, extract and group design but omits behavior and differs on feeding duration. Shared animals remain possible. None reports clinical apathy.
